nodes.description: Mapping of reflection balances used for all accounting and mutated in _transferStandard.
ERC20 allowance mapping written by _approve and read by allowance/transferFrom.
Total reflections, reduced by _reflectFee on every taxable transfer.
Reflection fee percentage, zeroed by removeAllFee and restored by restoreAllFee.
Team/marketing fee percentage, zeroed by removeAllFee and restored to 18 by restoreAllFee.
Maximum transfer amount enforced in _transfer and updated by openTrading/setMaxTxPercent.
Payable team address that receives half of the swapped ETH.
Payable marketing address that receives the other half of the swapped ETH.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for swaps, liquidity and approvals.
Token/ETH pair address created in openTrading and used for buy-side checks.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier around swapTokensForEth.
Flag enabling the automatic fee swap inside _transfer, set true by openTrading.
Flag gating the anti-bot cooldown logic, toggled by setCooldownEnabled.
Per-address timestamp cooldown map driven by block.timestamp.
Blacklist mapping set by setBots/delBot and checked in _transfer.
Contract owner used by the onlyOwner modifier and bypassed in _transfer fee/limit checks.
Flag set by openTrading to allow the one-time liquidity/initialization flow.
Fee-exemption mapping checked in _transfer before applying fees.
Private core transfer routine: enforces limits/blacklist/cooldown, performs the external fee swap and ETH payout, then updates balances.
Public ERC20 transfer forwarding _msgSender() to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens then decrements allowance.
Swaps contract token balance for ETH through the Uniswap router under lockTheSwap.
Splits accumulated ETH and pushes it to the team and marketing addresses via transfer.
Caller-restricted function letting _teamAddress trigger swapTokensForEth manually.
Caller-restricted function letting _teamAddress trigger sendETHToFee manually.
Owner-only initializer that sets the router, creates the pair, adds liquidity and opens trading.
Owner-only function flags a list of addresses as bots.
Owner-only toggle for the cooldown anti-bot mechanism.
Owner-only function recomputing _maxTxAmount from a percentage.
Private wrapper that temporarily disables fees and calls _transferStandard.
Private accounting routine that mutates _rOwned, takes the team fee and reflects the tax fee.
Private view helper computing reflection/fee amounts from _taxFee, _teamFee and _rTotal.
ERC20 balance query that converts _rOwned via tokenFromReflection.
ERC20 approve that writes _allowances through _approve.
Caller-controlled address used for transfers, approvals and every permission check.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for cooldowns and as the deadline of router calls.
External call to the Uniswap router executed during _transfer, before the sender/recipient balances are settled.
ETH push to the team address from within the transfer flow.
ETH push to the marketing address from within the transfer flow.
External payable liquidity call performed in openTrading with a timestamp deadline.
External factory call that deploys the token/ETH pair in openTrading.
Source address parameter of _transfer.
Destination address parameter of _transfer.
Amount parameter of _transfer validated against _maxTxAmount.
Local holding balanceOf(address(this)) that is swapped for ETH inside _transfer.
Token amount argument of swapTokensForEth passed to the router.
ETH amount argument of sendETHToFee that is split between the two fee receivers.
Array of addresses blacklisted by setBots.
Loop index iterating the bots array in setBots.
Percentage parameter used by setMaxTxPercent to recompute _maxTxAmount.

edges.reason: _msgSender() supplies the source address used by _transfer.
transfer() forwards _msgSender() as the sender.
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
manualswap() requires the caller to equal _teamAddress.
manualsend() requires the caller to equal _teamAddress.
setBots() is protected by the onlyOwner check on the caller.
setCooldownEnabled() is protected by onlyOwner.
setMaxTxPercent() is protected by onlyOwner.
openTrading() is protected by onlyOwner.
_transfer makes the external fee swap via swapTokensForEth before sender/recipient balances are updated.
_transfer pushes ETH to fee receivers inside the transfer path prior to balance settlement.
_transfer delegates the final accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to apply reflections.
_transferStandard obtains amount breakdown from _getValues.
_transfer compares from/to against _owner to bypass limits, blacklist and cooldown.
onlyOwner modifier on setBots compares _owner with the caller.
onlyOwner modifier on openTrading compares _owner with the caller.
onlyOwner modifier on setCooldownEnabled compares _owner with the caller.
onlyOwner modifier on setMaxTxPercent compares _owner with the caller.
swapTokensForEth calls the external Uniswap router swap entry point.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for approval and WETH path.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH out to the team address.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH out to the marketing address.
sendETHToFee reads _teamAddress as the first recipient.
sendETHToFee reads _marketingFunds as the second recipient.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth with the contract balance.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
openTrading performs the addLiquidityETH external call.
openTrading calls the factory to create the pair.
openTrading assigns the router address to uniswapV2Router.
openTrading assigns the created pair to uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading flips tradingOpen to true.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading resets _maxTxAmount to the full supply.
openTrading writes router allowance through _approve.
cooldown[to] is derived from block.timestamp, making the limit timestamp dependent.
_transfer enforces the buyer cooldown using block.timestamp.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
setBots writes true into the bots mapping.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
setMaxTxPercent rewrites _maxTxAmount.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned.
_getValues reads _taxFee to compute the tax portion.
_getValues reads _teamFee to compute the team portion.
_getValues reads _rTotal to derive the current rate.
_transfer reads the bots mapping to block flagged addresses.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount for the transfer limit check.
approve is part of the allowance/state flow that feeds the transfer routines.
transfer calls _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer.
balanceOf derives the visible balance from _rOwned.
from parameter is the source address validated and debited in _transfer.
to parameter is the destination address credited in _transfer.
amount parameter is checked against _maxTxAmount and forwarded to _tokenTransfer.
contractTokenBalance computed in _transfer is passed to the external swap.
tokenAmount parameter is the amountIn argument of the router swap.
amount parameter half is transferred to the team address.
amount parameter half is transferred to the marketing address.
bots_ array entries are written into the bots mapping.
local index i drives the blacklist loop in setBots.
maxTxPercent scales _maxTxAmount in setMaxTxPercent.
